description:
Follow-on AFTER Phase 2 (does not block it). Add a durable, append-only log of PureClaw-VISIBLE harness operations, distinct from the transcript and from the ephemeral in-memory registry. Scope: management/lifecycle/status events only (Spawned/Discovered/Adopted, status transitions Idle<->Thinking<->Exited<->Orphaned, ExternallyModified, Acknowledged, Dismissed, Evicted, Released) keyed by HarnessId, timestamped. NOT exhaustive — no visibility into Claude Code/etc internal actions; the transcript remains the interaction record.

Design notes / why it's a clean follow-on: it's an append-only LOG OF OPERATIONS, so the live registry stays ephemeral and Phase 2's hard-delete-on-eviction is fine — each op is recorded at occurrence (incl. the evict op). No retroactive capture needed; logging starts when shipped. Phase 2 already emits status transitions + a final disappearance ActivityChanged on eviction, which this can hook; spawn/dismiss/acknowledge emission can be added here too.

Likely shape: a HarnessActivityLog handle writing <HarnessId>-keyed JSONL (e.g. under the session/harness dir or a harness-activity/ dir); hook at each operation site (spawn in ClaudeCode/_fe_startHarness; transitions in Reconcile; dismiss/acknowledge/evict in the action handlers); a read endpoint + UI surface later.

Process: needs its own docs/harness-registry.md addition (a Harness Activity Log section) + the 5-agent design-review-gate before implementation (adds a persistence surface), then plan-review-gate + execution.
title: Harness activity log (post-Phase-2): append-only operations log for PureClaw-visible harness lifecycle

description: WU3b adversarial review identified that PureClaw.Frontend.Stream's startReplay runs synchronously inside the reader thread (readerLoop, Stream.hs:500-530, 584-624). The reader cannot receive the next inbound frame until startReplay returns and clears _conn_replayMode. Therefore abortInflightReplay (Stream.hs:563-573) is structurally dead code from the reader's perspective. The design contract (docs/transcript-streaming.md §Replay-on-reconnect) specifies 'a focus op while replay is in progress aborts the in-flight buffer and emits replay-aborted'. Current implementation cannot satisfy this. Fix: spawn startReplay in Async.withAsync so an incoming focus op can cancel it. Sub-test 1 of D40 in test/Frontend/StreamIntegrationSpec.hs:613-636 is currently PENDING with this rationale.
title: D40 spec divergence: spawn replay in Async to enable focus-during-replay abort

close_reason: Fixed in d2ea526 (c.4a): runTabbedLoop captures inbound source onto the active bound session; startProvider transcript reads it per-request. RED-tested (65b6385), both reviews PASS. phone+uuid restored in session.json + transcript.jsonl.
description: WU-8d.c migration surfaced a provenance regression from the 8c tabs cutover. The legacy loop wrapped the provider with mkTranscriptProvider passing (Just (_im_source msg)) (Loop.hs:198), so each turn's per-message MessageSource (e.g. Signal phone + uuid) was recorded into transcript.jsonl Request metadata.source. The new per-tab provider runtime (Wiring.hs startProvider:219) hardcodes Nothing, so per-message source is no longer written to the transcript. session.json still gets the source set-once via setSourceIfAbsent (_env_session), but the transcript dual-storage half is lost. Violates the everything-visible principle. Fix requires threading the per-message source into the per-tab runtime's transcript provider (source arrives per-message via handleInbound->sendTo->runtime input; runtime is built once per tab, so the source must flow with each turn). Repro: SignalFlowSpec dual-storage test, transcript.jsonl assertion, when repointed to runTabbedLoop.
notes: Fix design (Wiring-localized): (A) startProvider streamFn reads bound session sh _sm_source per-request into mkTranscriptProvider (replaces Nothing) -> transcript.jsonl; (B) runTabbedLoop loop captures msg source set-once onto the conversation's ACTIVE bound session (cursor->ref->store->setSourceIfAbsent; persists session.json via _sh_save) -> both halves. Root cause: source was captured on _env_session (foreground) not the tab's bound session. TDD red = dual-storage test repointed to runTabbedLoop.
title: [bug] Tabs cutover drops per-message source from transcript.jsonl (Wiring.hs:219 passes Nothing)
